skills.name: Common-denominator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find common denominators
skills.definition: Rewrite fractions with unlike denominators as equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Interpret and subtract expressions involving whole numbers and mixed numbers by managing whole-number and fractional parts.

skills.name: Regroup or rename
skills.definition: Regroup or rename whole numbers and mixed numbers, including improper fractional parts, when direct fractional subtraction is not possible.
